model_configuration.feature_contract: nonnegative finite float32, little endian, signed zero canonicalized
model_configuration.fit_weight: population stratum count / sampled stratum count, then class balancing by population class totals
model_configuration.hyperparameter_selection: none; all fixed families are reported

operating_point.rule: strictly above normal order statistic, preserve ties, no test tuning

model_configuration.sample_method: bottom-k SplitMix64 priority of source file ordinal and CSV row index, independent of values
model_configuration.study_status: prespecified after exploratory analysis; test days previously inspected
model_configuration.uncertainty: paired UTC-day block bootstrap only if >=8 observed test days; otherwise descriptive leave-one-day-out, no CI
